newsitem.title: UK: LME nearby copper spreads flare in ring trading.
newsitem.headline: LME nearby copper spreads flare in ring trading.

text.p: COPPER - Three months hovers above $2,400 in 1st ring as tight dates become prompt. Cash/day trades up to $16 back, ends ring at $8. Cash/threes offered at $200 back.
ALUMINIUM - Threes/Average 1998 spread flips into backwardation, bid at $11 back from $17/$20 contango on Friday.
OTHERS - Off highs but firmer with copper, aluminium.
